scenarios.title: Three steps in a straight line
scenarios.description: Load three numbers, calculate their sum, then format the result. Every step reads the previous step's recorded output.
guide: Step through LoadNumbers, Sum and FormatResult in order.
Open Developer to compare numbers, sum and result at each stop.
Trace result back through sum to the originally loaded numbers.

scenarios.title: An unexpected price
scenarios.description: A deliberately wrong lookup selects the last rate instead of the cheapest. An audit step sits in the history but does not feed the price.
scenarios.outcome: Quote: 11.88. The selected base rate is 9.9; the cheapest available rate was 3.1.
guide: Select Quote in the chart or timeline, then open Developer.
Trace quote to see the recorded inputs baseRate and riskFactor.
Follow baseRate back to PickBase and LoadRates. Audit is a chronological neighbor with no recorded input to the quote.

scenarios.title: Two branches, one combined total
scenarios.description: Two selected branches independently calculate item and delivery amounts. The join reads both branch results from their recorded runs namespaces.
guide: Follow RunCalculations as it fans out into Items and Delivery, then rejoins at Combine.
Inspect the branch outputs under runs.items and runs.delivery.
Select Combine to see both amounts used in the final total. Parallel completion order can vary; the result remains 35.

scenarios.title: Refine until the third visit
scenarios.description: Refine increases a score by four on each visit. Review follows the loop back twice and breaks when the score reaches twelve.
scenarios.outcome: Three Refine visits, three Review visits, score 12 and accepted = true.
guide: Play the repeated Refine and Review visits on the time rail.
Compare attempt and score as the same chart nodes are visited again.
Trace score from the final visit and look for the earlier passes, then inspect the recorded break in Commentary.

scenarios.title: A retry that recovers
scenarios.description: A local simulated quote service fails twice, then succeeds. FetchQuote allows three attempts; Settle also has a retry policy but succeeds on its first try.
scenarios.outcome: FetchQuote succeeded on attempt 3. Settlement: 4,150 for 100 units at 41.50 each.
guide: Play to FetchQuote and look for its three-attempt badge.
Open Developer to inspect the recorded retry activity, then Commentary to follow the recovery.
Compare Settle: it declares retries but has no retry badge because it succeeded immediately.

scenarios.title: Repeated names in separate subflows
scenarios.description: Two root Prepare mounts and a nested Pipeline → Prepare all contain Clean, Scale and Sum. Their exact recorded paths keep their states separate.
scenarios.outcome: First total: 20. Second total: 6. Nested pipeline total: 23. Grand total: 49.
guide: Open Topology and drill into each Prepare mount; the identical stage labels belong to separate paths.
Open Pipeline, then its nested Prepare, and compare its input and total with the two root mounts.
Use the breadcrumbs to return to the root and inspect Report. Root commits show mount outputs; child history is inspected inside its own recorded scope.
